title: Vision Vendor MTA API Contract v1
description: E-signature flow for the Master Teaming Agreement. New router backend/api/routes/vendor_agreements.py (prefix /api/vendors). Audit trail per E-SIGN Act (15 U.S.C. §7001) / GA UETA (O.C.G.A. §10-12): intent (consent checkbox), attribution (user_id + typed name/title), exact document version (content_hash of signed PDF bytes).

document_id.description: documents row for the signed PDF

expires_at.description: executed_at + 2 years (MTA Art. 8.1); informational, not gated

signed_ip.description: request.client.host; proxy caveat — X-Forwarded-For NOT trusted (no TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS flag this build)

content_hash.description: sha256 hex of render pass-1 bytes with the random trailer /ID stripped (signature block + Exhibit A included; the embedded hash line is appended in pass 2). Reproducible by re-rendering from stored inputs (profile, signer, executed_at->UTC).

MtaStatusResponse.description: GET /api/vendors/mta response. Unsigned state renders the MTA PDF server-side (party block filled from profile) and returns a 1h presigned preview URL — no documents row exists until signing.

signed_name.description: Typed legal name of the authorized signatory — constitutes the electronic signature

consent.description: Must be true server-side; false → 400. The checkbox is not just UI — it is the intent record.

get_my_mta.summary: Vendor's MTA status. Role must be 'vendor' (403 otherwise). 404 if the vendor user has no vendor_profiles row (e.g. admin-created user without profile).

404.description: No vendor profile for this user

sign_my_mta.summary: Execute the MTA. Idempotent: repeat POST with an existing executed MTA returns the existing row (200, already_signed=true) — DB-level guard is the partial unique index uq_vta_one_executed_mta. New execution → 201.

404.description: No vendor profile (cannot fill party block)

list_agreements_admin.summary: Admin listing of teaming agreements, joined with users.username and documents.name. Optional agreement_type query filter.

gate.name: require_mta
gate.description: FastAPI dependency in backend/auth/__init__.py. Vendor role without an executed MTA row → 403 'Master Teaming Agreement required...'. Non-vendor roles pass (JQ staff). Future vendor-facing quote endpoints use Depends(require_mta).
